### 功能需求

写一个 bash 脚本 `scripts/switch_model.sh`，实现 vLLM 模型快速切换：

支持的 model_name 和对应路径：

|-----------|---------|------|
| qwen-14b | /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct (或实际路径) | 8000 |
| mistral-7b | /root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0___3 | 8000 |
| llama-8b | /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct | 8000 |
| deepseek-r1 | /root/autodl-tmp/models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B | 8000 |
| qwen-7b | (待确认路径) | 8000 |

### 实现逻辑

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# switch_model.sh — 快速切换 vLLM 服务模型
# 用法: ./switch_model.sh <model_name>
# 功能: kill 当前 vLLM → 启动新模型 → 等待 health check

set -e

MODEL_NAME="${1:?Usage: $0 <model_name>}"

# 1. Kill 当前所有 vLLM 进程
pkill -f "vllm.serve" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 3

# 2. 根据 model_name 设置路径和参数
case "$MODEL_NAME" in
  qwen-14b) MODEL_PATH="..." ; EXTRA_ARGS="" ;;
  mistral-7b) MODEL_PATH="..." ; EXTRA_ARGS="" ;;
  ...
esac

# 3. 启动 vLLM（nohup 后台）
nohup python -m vllm.serve "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --max-model-len 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --dtype auto \
  $EXTRA_ARGS > /tmp/vllm_${MODEL_NAME}.log 2>&1 &

echo "Started vLLM for $MODEL_NAME (PID: $!)"

# 4. Health check（等待 /health 返回 200）
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -s http://localhost:8000/health | grep -q "ok\|200"; then
    echo "✓ vLLM ready for $MODEL_NAME"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "✗ Timeout waiting for vLLM health check"
exit 1
```

4. 验证语法：`bash -n scripts/switch_model.sh`

5. 确认 `chmod +x scripts/switch_model.sh`
